Counts per era over the read papers, recomputed under four codings. Era sample sizes: Era 0 n=0, Era 1 n=0, Era 2 n=11, Era 3 n=16, Era 4 n=12, Era 5 n=9, Era 6 n=10.

## G1: irregular ownership and the run-time stage

The claim: where ownership is set by an irregular or user-defined map and the system generates the
communication for it, a run-time stage (inspection or adaptation during execution) is recorded.
Population A is every read paper with irregular or user-defined ownership. Population B keeps the
papers whose communication is generated by the system (any communication value other than
programmer-explicit). Population B is the claim's own scope, and it was fixed after the Era 4 papers
were coded: Co-Array Fortran leaves communication to the programmer, so it is outside the claim.
The load-time variant counts load-time evaluation of a user map as a run-time stage.

- population A (irregular or user-defined ownership), first: 18 of 22 have a run-time stage; exceptions: chapman1991vienna, chapman1992vienna, diaconescu2005reusable, diaconescu2006userdefined; exceptions if load time counts: diaconescu2005reusable, diaconescu2006userdefined
- population A (irregular or user-defined ownership), second: 17 of 22 have a run-time stage; exceptions: chen1988compiling, numrich1998coarray, chamberlain2007chapel, diaconescu2005reusable, diaconescu2006userdefined; exceptions if load time counts: chen1988compiling, chamberlain2007chapel
- population A (irregular or user-defined ownership), intersection: 14 of 19 have a run-time stage; exceptions: chapman1991vienna, chapman1992vienna, chamberlain2007chapel, diaconescu2005reusable, diaconescu2006userdefined; exceptions if load time counts: chamberlain2007chapel, diaconescu2005reusable, diaconescu2006userdefined
- population A (irregular or user-defined ownership), union: 22 of 25 have a run-time stage; exceptions: numrich1998coarray, diaconescu2005reusable, diaconescu2006userdefined; exceptions if load time counts: none
- population B (claim scope: system-generated communication), first: 17 of 19 have a run-time stage; exceptions: chapman1991vienna, chapman1992vienna; exceptions if load time counts: none
- population B (claim scope: system-generated communication), second: 17 of 20 have a run-time stage; exceptions: chen1988compiling, numrich1998coarray, diaconescu2006userdefined; exceptions if load time counts: chen1988compiling
- population B (claim scope: system-generated communication), intersection: 14 of 16 have a run-time stage; exceptions: chapman1991vienna, chapman1992vienna; exceptions if load time counts: none
- population B (claim scope: system-generated communication), union: 21 of 23 have a run-time stage; exceptions: numrich1998coarray, diaconescu2006userdefined; exceptions if load time counts: none

## G2: decision procedure by era (papers per procedure)

The claim tested here is that search-based decomposition is absent before 2019. Falsifiers are read papers
before 2019 whose decision procedure is profile or search, under each coding:

- first: before 2019: hiranandani1992evaluation; from 2019: 4 papers
- second: before 2019: su2010irregular; from 2019: 3 papers
